## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Resolution of Doubts about the Cān tóng qì*

by [俞琰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BF%9E%E7%90%B0) (Yǔ Yǎn, 1245–1314)

Yǔ Yǎn's **companion-text to his [KR5d0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5d/KR5d0022) *Fā huī***, handling specific philological and interpretive difficulties in the *Cān tóng qì*. Preface dated 1281, preceding the full *Fā huī* (1284). Preserved as **DZ 1006** / CT 1006 (Tài xuán bù 太玄部).

**Dating.** 1281. Dynasty: 宋-元.
